material.description: OpenStax Introduction to Political Science, §§1.4–1.5 “Normative Political Science” and “Empirical Political Science” (https://openstax.org/books/introduction-political-science/pages/1-4-normative-political-science; https://openstax.org/books/introduction-political-science/pages/1-5-empirical-political-science): §1.4 treats normative inquiry as questions about what should be and ideal political goals; §1.5 contrasts empirical inquiry into what is, using evidence to describe and explain political reality. The sections distinguish these question types while noting that empirical findings can inform normative judgments.
